edition: Harmonies Pulse final printed ten-card pack (2026)

reference.role: Readable original of the all-ten printed-card photograph supplied by the user; reference only, not runtime artwork.

corrections: Camel requires a completed building of height 2, not a red ground token of height 1.
Beetle and yak have collinear three-cell patterns; do not convert them to bent chains.
Panda and piranha require wood/wood/leaf trees of height 3.
Robin uses a three-cell triangle and a completed building of height 2.
